cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Base can't hear our ship's report. We were secretly sent to receive. I'm switching channels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only static. I need a forecast before my watch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. That's applause. Our real mission is entertaining base. I'm singing the forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now they've switched off. You've lost our audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this was rejection training. I'm handing you the microphone; refuse me a second verse.

mechanism: A commands the ship's response by replacing every failed communication goal with a new secret mission and immediately assigning its action.
confusable: Unlike claiming an unchanged objective is succeeding, A shifts receive to entertain to practice rejection.
comparison: Shipboard forecast pressure and microphone handoff differ from a treasure-map wall and breath holding.
seedUse: The seed already changes channels, sings and hands over the microphone with a command, directly enacting S01 control of the new goals.
